shortDescription:
Name: Blanko Dawn Perfume
Type: Eau de Parfum (EDP)
Fragrance Family: Fresh, Floral & Musky
Quantity: 100 ML
Suitable For: Women
Application: Daily wear, office, casual outings, gifting
description: Blanko Dawn Perfume is a refreshing and elegant fragrance that captures the beauty of a new beginning — light, radiant, and full of life. Designed for the modern woman who embraces every day with confidence and grace, this scent embodies femininity and freshness in perfect harmony.The fragrance opens with bright citrus and green top notes, evoking the crispness of early morning air. The heart blossoms into a soft bouquet of delicate florals, offering a romantic and graceful touch. The base is wrapped in gentle musk and creamy woods, creating a smooth, long-lasting trail that lingers beautifully on the skin.Presented in a chic 100ML bottle, Blanko Dawn is the perfect companion for everyday elegance and effortless charm.✨ Key Highlights:Refreshing floral-musky fragrance for women.Ideal for daily wear, office, or daytime events.Long-lasting and soft on the senses.Symbolizes freshness, femininity, and renewal.Elegant bottle design — a beautiful gifting choice.
